notes.title: Spring Update!
notes.content:
Spring brings a fresh update to The 13th Floor! We've added a new map to explore, featuring more intense anomalies and fresh challenges. If you struggle to complete a level, you'll now receive tips to help you understand what to do next.

Additionally, the game interface now supports multiple languages, and we've fixed several bugs to ensure a smoother experience. Get ready to dive into the unknown!

🔹 New map – tougher anomalies, more exploration
🔹 Tip system – extra help if you fail multiple times
🔹 More language support – a more accessible experience
🔹 Bug fixes – smoother gameplay

It's time to return to The 13th Floor!
